summary: Lando Norris won the British Grand Prix from P3 on the grid, 6.8s ahead of Oscar Piastri, with Nico Hulkenberg completing the podium.
Nico Hulkenberg made the biggest climb, from P19 to P3.
Charles Leclerc had a day to forget, dropping from P6 to P14.
The race was neutralised by 2 safety cars and 2 virtual safety cars.
The stewards penalised PIA (10 second time penalty) and TSU (10 second time penalty).
There were 35 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Rain fell at some point during the race.
Oscar Piastri leads the championship by 8 points over Lando Norris.
